sections.head: Test accessibility where you already test

items.a: Accessibility testing checks that people with disabilities can use a website or app, including people who use screen readers, keyboards or magnification.

items.q: Which standards does TestMu AI check?
items.a: WCAG 2.2, ADA, Section 508 and the European Accessibility Act.

items.q: Can automated tools find every accessibility issue?
items.a: No. Automated scans catch a large share of issues, but some need a human with assistive technology. TestMu AI combines scans with real devices and screen readers.

items.q: Does it test native mobile apps?
items.a: Yes. TestMu AI scans native iOS and Android apps on real devices, as well as websites.

items.q: Can I add accessibility checks to my existing tests?
items.a: Yes. Add checks to Selenium, Playwright and Cypress tests, or use Accessibility DevTools in the browser.
